ache.title: “Regardless of your luck” still means luck rules
ache.note: Day one of Zenless Zone Zero, and Nero already promises to help you build ‘regardless of your gacha luck’. That’s kind, and it also admits the base problem: the game runs on luck, and launch already has a meta to catch up with. Starting a new game shouldn’t feel like being behind.
ache.tip: In a new game, play first and read the meta later. Being new doesn’t mean you’re late.
lines: day one and there’s already homework
bad luck is the game working as designed
